stepTitle: Refresh the vendored upstream baseline to what the Claude plugin actually does today
acceptanceCriteria: The vendored tree reflects the current upstream source repo for parity-relevant files, obvious junk files are excluded, and the repo has a reliable local baseline for intended-vs-actual analysis.

findings.detail: look-before-you-leap/.DS_Store exists on disk. While it appears to be handled by a global gitignore (git status shows clean), the project .gitignore has __pycache__ and *.pyc but not .DS_Store. Adding .DS_Store to .gitignore makes the exclusion explicit and portable across machines that may not have a global gitignore.

findings.summary: __pycache__ directories exist on disk in vendored tree
findings.detail: Three __pycache__ dirs with .pyc files exist under look-before-you-leap/. They are gitignored and won't be committed, but the acceptance criteria say 'obvious junk files are excluded.' These are excluded from git but not from the filesystem. This is cosmetic — git status is clean for them.
